topic: Identify the type of blood cell that carries oxygen throughout the body
core_question: Which type of blood cell is primarily responsible for carrying oxygen throughout the human body? (secondary: Who co-founded Microsoft together with Bill Gates in 1975?)
answer_summary: Red blood cells (erythrocytes), which contain hemoglobin and transport oxygen through the bloodstream.; after the topic shift: Accept 'Paul Allen' — co-founded Microsoft with Bill Gates in 1975.
